confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough and drawn from travel-blog and guide rupee figures of mixed dates, converted at an assumed exchange rate of about INR 88 to 90 per USD; beer and cocktail values are less certain. Searches found no menu-level prices for cocktails or wine in Leh, so those values are estimated from local beer prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live listings. FX value 0.6720 (18 Nov 2026) was taken from search-result text attributed to the RBA, and I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was modelled. The basis is Indian high-altitude hill-station tourist towns (such as Manali and Shimla), adjusted for Leh's seasonal peak demand and remote supply costs, with food pricing based on the Leh dhaba, mid-range restaurant and cafe price bands found in the searches.
